targets.recommended_evidence_quality_note: V3-EXQ-569c (2026-05-30) tested SD-056 against ARC-065 GAP-A R1.b as a matched-entropy FP-2 falsifier. Headline result: ON arms (sd056_weight 0.01/0.05/0.20) produce selected_action_entropy 0.875/0.833/0.951 vs matched-noise control (ARM_4 T=2.5) at 0.414 -- ~2.4x above the FP-2 control on the C3 acceptance axis. Pre-registered C1 floor (cand_world_pairwise_dist > 0.05) was not cleared by 2/3-seed majority (ON-arm means 0.045/0.042/0.046; per-seed seeds-above-floor 1/0/1). The C1 floor was calibrated against V3-EXQ-613 standalone-task magnitude (0.286) rather than behavioural-runtime magnitude (~0.045); ON arms cluster at 3x bit-identical noise (0.0148), confirming the substrate is operative. Per /failure-autopsy V3-EXQ-569c 2026-05-30: routed to /queue-experiment for V3-EXQ-569d (recalibrated C1 floor + e3_top2_class_gap NaN fix) and V3-EXQ-569e (mechanism probe dissociating per-candidate-variance propagation vs E2-rollout-dynamics shift as source of the C3 lift). Evidence direction for ARC-065 upgraded supports per the matched-noise control clearance on C3; MECH-341 supports preserved.

recommended_substrate_queue_entry.rationale: Substrate is operative (3x baseline pairwise distance + decisive matched-noise clearance on C3). Failure mode is test-design calibration (C1 floor magnitude) + measurement instrumentation (e3_top2_class_gap NaN). Both addressable in /queue-experiment redesign without a substrate amendment.

learning_extracted: Substrate operative at 3x baseline pairwise_dist; C1 floor 0.05 was calibrated against V3-EXQ-613 standalone-task magnitude (0.286), not behavioural-runtime magnitude (~0.045); floor recalibration to ~0.03 would discriminate noise (0.015) from substrate-operative (0.045) without rejecting realistic behavioural-runtime regimes.

Matched-entropy control (ARM_4 T=2.5) achieves selected_action_entropy 0.414 vs OFF baseline 0.361 -- pure softmax temperature contributes ~0.05 entropy. ON arms achieve 0.83-0.95 -- ~2.4x noise control. Decisive evidence that SD-056 produces structural diversity not explained by entropy injection.

Pre-registered interpretation grid did not anticipate the observed outcome shape (C1 borderline + C2 PASS + strong C3 lift above matched-noise). The two prepared rows (C1 PASS + C2/C3 FAIL -> MECH-341 load-bearing; C1 FAIL -> SD-056 wiring gap) mis-route the actual case. Grid should be extended in 569d / 569e pre-registration to cover this case.

e3_top2_class_gap NaN on every ON arm (ARM_0 + ARM_4 populated cleanly) is an instrumentation bug that blocks the most informative score-margin-vs-class-collapse dissociation channel. Must be fixed in 569d / 569e.

Mechanism question (569e): is the C3 lift coming from per-candidate z_world variance propagation through E3 scoring (Pathway A: ~3x C1 lift -> small but real score differences -> different class selection), OR from E2 rollout dynamics shifts induced by contrastive training that affect downstream E3 scoring independent of within-tick per-candidate variance (Pathway B: E2 sees a different scoring problem)? Current measurement stack cannot dissociate.

Contrastive_loss across ON arms stayed at ~1.95 (near ln(8)=2.08 random baseline) under 30 ep P0 + 20 ep P1 budget; the head has not fully trained in behavioural-runtime sparsity. Either extend the warmup budget or document the buffer-warmup-to-effect curve.

C2 PASS at parity with matched-noise (ARMs 1/3 at 0.796/0.791 strictly > ARM_4 at 0.786; ARM_2 at 0.786 tied) is a near-degenerate criterion under these conditions -- noise temperature reaches the same candidate-pool entropy as SD-056 + temperature 1.0 ON. C2 is weakly discriminative; the load-bearing falsifier is C3 (selected entropy above noise control).
